You're right to flag that — looks like the calendar invite was created in UTC and then interpreted as a local midnight in some timezones. The intended slot for the demo was Dec 1 at 09:30 SGT, which is:
- 10:30 JST (Tokyo)
- 11:30 AEDT (Sydney, daylight time)

So the invite should have read Dec 1, 09:30 SGT / 10:30 JST / 11:30 AEDT. I can update the invite to explicitly list local times to avoid the cutover confusion.

If 09:30 SGT / 10:30 JST works for your Tokyo and Singapore teams but is late for Sydney, we can move earlier to 08:30 SGT / 09:30 JST / 10:30 AEDT — would that help?

I've cc'd Ben and Tessa to coordinate the reschedule. I will send an updated .ics with clear local times once we confirm.

Apologies again — timezone slips are embarrassingly common.
